# Core Packages

These packages are integrated directly into the Big Bang umbrella chart. The catalog metadata determines their configuration identity and Big Bang integration guide; `chart/values.yaml` supplies the release-pinned package source.

Use the integration guide for Big Bang-specific behavior. Use the package repository for the packaged chart values, changelog, and implementation details.
